newsitem.title: USA: GST Telecommunications unit files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: GST Telecommunications unit files for IPO.

text.p: NACT Telecommunications Inc Inc, a unit GST Telecommunications Inc, said Monday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 3,000,000 shares of its common stock.
NACT said it will sell 2,000,000 shares. An additional 1,000,000 shares of its common stock will be sold by a selling stockholder, the company said.
It said GST provides a broad range of integrated telecommunications products and services through the development and operation of competitive access and other telecommunications networks.
